title: A dual function attaining the conjugate norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q\in\mathbb R$ be Hölder conjugates, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. There is a function $g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ whose uniform $p$-norm is at most $1$ and whose uniform inner product with $f$ equals the uniform $q$-norm of $f$.
